title: EU868 duty-cycle oracle uses 200 ms while same artifact computes 369.664 ms
description: Correctness review: spec/09-packets-timing.md:141-149 and packets-timing.json duty_cycle_eu868_10pct use 200 ms for a 60-byte SF9/125kHz frame and derive 1800 packets/hour at 10%. The same generated artifact airtime_sf9_60b independently applies the stated LoRa parameters and yields 369.664 ms (packets-timing.json around lines 150-158), giving floor(360 seconds / 0.369664) = 973 whole packets/hour, not 1800. generate_packets_timing.py uses a hard-coded timing constant for one vector and computed airtime for the other. Use one explicit complete PHY parameter set and derive duty capacity from the same independent formula.
